purpose: Compare two selected vehicle telemetry histories using quantile-state mutual information rather than linear correlation.
primaryGoal: Choose two signals, understand aligned-sample coverage and nonlinear dependence, review permutation significance, and inspect joint-state contributions without changing source measurements.

dataSources.name: Signal catalog
dataSources.behavior: Enabled for a positive vehicle ID; normalizes names from bare arrays or signals envelopes, discards malformed entries, uses the existing catalog query key and STANDARD stale time, and forwards cancellation.

dataSources.name: Two independent selected signal histories
dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle and nonempty signal enable each query independently; vehicle/name/hours participate in cache keys; STANDARD polling and AbortSignal forwarding remain. Returned data/from/to are retained. No explicit limit, from/to range or server-completeness guarantee is supplied by this page.
dataSources.unknowns: Handler internals, actual response coverage, ordering/limits, production units and deployed availability were not exercised or inferred.

dataSources.name: Local mutual-information derivation
dataSources.behavior: Pure analysis of raw history samples: valid numeric kinds and boolean 0/1 promotion; invalid timestamps/nonfinite values and other kinds excluded; last valid duplicate timestamp wins; larger median positive cadence, overlap-only nearest alignment within 1.5 cadences; minimum 20 aligned points, four quantile bins, 200 deterministic permutations, 95% null quantile; returns 16 cells plus aligned samples and specialist statistics.

dataSources.name: Existing workspace and formatting preferences
dataSources.behavior: Shared selected vehicle owner uses URL/store/fleet fallback; page does not introduce a second vehicle picker. Numeric output subscribes to existing locale/precision preferences through useNumberFormatting. The selected-vehicle hook depends on useVehicles; that hook's endpoint was not inspected.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.behavior: Full-width min-w-0 adapter; shared header/help, worst-query freshness, source notices and page error boundary, not a new shell.

components.name: TelemetrySummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.behavior: Existing operational metric adapter, trust labels, bounds disclosure and Review details drawer. Keep the shared renderer and all four specialist metrics.

components.name: ChartContainer and chart category exports
components.behavior: One contribution bar series; accessible fallback data table; default image export eligibility when populated. No CSV exportData, fullscreen, chartKey, annotation configuration or legend-toggle capability is supplied by this page.

components.name: Select
components.behavior: Native labeled selection with existing focus styles and shared option rendering.

components.name: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Badge
components.inspectionLimit: Call sites inspected; these primitive implementations were not individually inspected.

components.name: FadeIn
components.behavior: Existing reduced-motion hook controls entrance initial state, delay and duration. Runtime OS/low-bandwidth behavior unverified.

components.name: NoVehicleSelected and feedback owners
components.behavior: Shared setup navigation and governed prerequisite guidance. QueryError, Skeleton and EmptyState call sites remain shared feedback, not local substitutes.

components.name: DataSourceNotice / useDataState
components.behavior: Existing source-level pending/failure/refresh/offline notices and retry; useDataState separates fatal failures from retained refresh errors.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: The same history fatal failure is shown after the summary, in the chart replacement, and inside the heatmap, in addition to the shared source notice. Retry scopes differ: the summary refreshes catalog and both histories, while the other two retry only failed histories.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consolidate the page-level failure explanation and affected-source recovery using the existing shared source notice/QueryError owners; keep identifiable chart and heatmap sections and retain intentional retry scopes.

sourceBehavior: Selection grid stacks below sm and uses two columns at sm: page lines 177-199.
Heatmap uses two columns below sm and four at sm: page line 292; all cells remain present.
Shared PageLayout provides @container, w-full and min-w-0: PageLayout.tsx:12.
Chart is responsive width/height inside a fixed 320px requested frame: page lines 246,254.

issues.detail: Up to 12 pair labels are rendered with a fixed 10px X-axis font; Y-axis uses 11px. Small allocated widths and larger text preferences require review; actual crowding is not proved.
issues.fix: Use existing chart typography/axis formatting and frame sizing rather than ad-hoc axis font sizes; verify every contribution remains accessible through the existing table at all required widths.

responsive.viewportValidation: NOTRUN: 320,375,390,430,768,1024,1280,1440,1920,2560; allocated-container, RTL and 200%-text checks unverified.

sourceStrengths: Decorative heading icons are aria-hidden: page lines 161,274.
Both Select controls have localized visible labels; native control association exists in Select.tsx:69-85.
Chart has ariaLabel and three-column same-plotted-data fallback: page lines 239-252.
Heatmap retains textual pair/count/bits, accessible cell descriptions and nonzero probability badges: page lines 300-327.
Shared FadeIn honors reduced-motion input in source; shared summary owns its details drawer.

issues.detail: Page supplies labels but no explicit IDs at lines 178-191; Select derives identity from translated label before falling back to useId. Locale changes can change the control identity; a collision on this page is not established.
issues.fix: Existing Select owner should use stable implicit useId while preserving explicit id precedence and feedback associations; alternatively the page can pass stable distinct explicit IDs without changing values.

issues.detail: Page uses default md sizing, whose source minimum is 40px rather than the contract's stronger 44px mobile default. Rendered size and WCAG target-spacing exceptions are unmeasured.
issues.fix: Reuse existing Select size prop, e.g. lg where appropriate, or have the shared owner review the established mobile sizing contract. Do not introduce another select.

accessibility.validation: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen-reader output, composed contrast, touch targets, forced colors and actual reduced-motion behavior NOTRUN.

states.loading: Catalog Skeleton(96); history analysis loading preserves retained data and drives summary/chart/heatmap skeletons. Source notice tracks enabled histories independently: page lines 50-54,108-112,166-167,204,244,277-278.
states.empty: Catalog empty guidance; no selection produces unknown metrics and selection prompt; insufficient aligned samples produces minimum-20 explanation; chart emptiness derives from top-contribution rows: page lines 168-175,245,283-290.
states.error: Fatal errors only replace dependent results. Catalog failure is separate. Summary retry refreshes all three source queries; chart/heatmap retry failed histories: page lines 164-165,113-119,220-231,279-283.
states.retained: Retained histories survive refresh errors; summary marks retained for refreshing/stale/refreshError and exposes requested/returned bounds: page lines 206-219. Shared source notice supplies nonfatal warnings.
states.offline: Existing data-state adapter maps retained paused queries to stale; shared source notice marks initial paused loads and offers retry. Actual browser offline behavior NOTRUN.
states.unknown: Null result and missing selection keep KPI values null, never fabricated zero. Returned bounds not supplied are explicitly described as unknown by the summary owner.

issues.detail: Both history states pass provenance only. Empty successful arrays therefore are not marked unavailable, and partial source coverage is not derived here. The summary's partial/unavailable branches at lines 206-207 cannot represent sample-level exclusions from these options alone.
issues.fix: Derive unavailable from a resolved empty history using existing useDataState options; qualify supported partial coverage from real response/sample evidence only. Keep unknown result distinct from zero, failure and empty, and preserve independent retries.

issues.detail: PageLayout receives query/dataSources but no loading/busy/error props. PageContainer's announcement at lines 134-140 and aria-busy at line 163 are driven by those props, not by the supplied queries. Shared source notice/chart may communicate their own states; complete announcement behavior is untested.
issues.fix: Consider passing busy for active enabled source work without using global loading to hide independent sections. Verify live-region behavior before adding competing announcements.

visualIssues.detail: Local sign-based bg-rose-500/bg-cyan-500 with four opacity bands establishes a saturated heat palette independent of shared chart tokens. Two decorative icons also use fixed text-cyan-300 at lines 161 and 274. No neon/glow/pure-white/shadow literal was found in the assigned page; composed appearance and effective contrast are unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Map heat intensity/sign to existing restrained semantic/chart tokens while retaining all cells, sign/intensity distinctions and numeric text; make decorative icons token-neutral. Preserve saved palette preferences rather than resetting them.

visualIssues.detail: Cell colors encode sign and relative absolute contribution, but the heatmap has no visible key explaining hue/intensity. Signed bit values provide a non-color representation, so this is an explanation gap rather than proof of color-only content.
visualIssues.fix: Add localized concise sign/intensity guidance within the existing panel; retain per-cell count, signed bits, pair identity and probability.

architectureIssues.detail: Shared useSignalHistory interpolates the signal name without encodeURIComponent. Current catalog names and whether they ever contain reserved characters were not verified; this is a source-level transport risk, not a observed 404.
architectureIssues.fix: Existing hook owner can encode the path segment without changing cache identity, cancellation, polling or payloads; validate against actual catalog/router behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Provenance says aligned numeric samples only, but signalMutualInformation.ts:94 calls the extractor with boolean promotion enabled, and signalHistorySamples.ts:34-36 maps booleans to 0/1.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the existing analysis behavior and clarify localized provenance that numeric and supported boolean measurements participate; do not remove boolean evidence or alter quantile/permutation calculations as a cosmetic fix.

priority.reason: The page already reuses shared layout, metrics, chart, feedback and formatting owners. Prioritize honest empty/source trust, consolidated recovery, stable field identity and restrained/explained heat encoding; browser acceptance remains pending.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Stable implicit Select field identity
variants: Existing sm/md/lg/auto; no new variant proposed
dependsOn: existing React useId and explicit-ID behavior
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Extend only the existing primitive owner; no new component/library. This audit confirms two controls on one page, not two independent production-page consumers. Cross-page adoption/acceptance belongs to the shared owner.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Signal-history path-segment encoding review
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Integration review, not a proved runtime failure. Preserve existing query keys/polling and raw payloads.

competingImplementations.name: Local heat-color classification
competingImplementations.detail: heatClass is a local presentation mapping while the bar already uses chartTokens.series[0]. Align colors with the existing token owner, not a new global heatmap engine.

competingImplementations.name: Repeated fatal-history recovery
competingImplementations.detail: Three page recovery sites plus the existing shared source notice; reuse established owners and preserve section visibility.

preservation.countNote: Three GlassPanel JSX sites include the alternative fatal chart panel; four logical content sections, not four simultaneously mounted GlassPanels. Shared summary internals and no-vehicle fallback are additional inherited surfaces.
actions: Choose/clear Signal A and Signal B using existing shared Select controls, including selecting the same signal if desired.
Summary fatal-error retry refreshes catalog and both histories.
Chart and heatmap fatal retries target only failed histories.
Shared DataSourceNotice retry targets its retryable sources.
Review details opens existing OperationalBrief drawer; shared close behavior remains.
Populated chart exposes default shared image export menu; no CSV/fullscreen/annotation capability is configured here.
No-vehicle setup action links through existing guidance to onboarding.
Shared compact page-header subtitle/help action remains available.
dataBehavior: Preserve supplied route, shared vehicle scope, empty initial signal choices, and fixed 24-hour analysis request; resolve any future workspace-range policy with its existing integration owner, not a second local range picker.
Preserve raw SI wire/cache values, history query keys, enablement, polling, cancellation, independent sources and retained histories.
Preserve valid numeric and boolean promotion behavior, last-valid timestamp deduplication, cadence alignment/tolerance, minimum samples, bins, deterministic permutation threshold and rounding.
Preserve all derived cells/aligned sample metadata even where only some fields currently display; do not change scientific calculations during presentation modernization.
Preserve locale/precision-aware scientific/count/percent/cadence formatting and null-as-unknown metric values.
Preserve top-12 ordering, signed contributions, same-data fallback table, all heat cells and count-positive probability badge condition.
Retain localized explanations, requested 24h/selected-pair scope, aligned-overlap caveat, supplied bounds and honest unknown bounds.

evidenceLimits.scope: Atomic Phase0 source audit of the assigned page and direct page-specific owners only. Route array is supplied by assignment; mounted route reachability was not tested.
evidenceLimits.typescript: NOTRUN by assignment: no full-project validation during source audit.
evidenceLimits.lintBuildTests: NOTRUN by assignment; no Git commands or source edits.
evidenceLimits.skillScript: audit.sh was read but not executed because it unconditionally runs full frontend TypeScript, contrary to this bounded source-only assignment. Its categories were counted directly on the assigned file instead.

sourceChecks.interpretation: Counts are syntactic indicators, not visual acceptance or a zero-violation certificate. Saturated count is two background literals plus two icon literals.
sourceChecks.failedAttempt: Initial PowerShell regex-count command exited 1 with ParserError before counting; successful Python retry supplies the evidence.
